title: gossip
summary: Benilla defines CMSG_GOSSIP_HELLO, CMSG_GOSSIP_SELECT_OPTION (optional trailing code cstring omitted when absent), CMSG_NPC_TEXT_QUERY, the SMSG_GOSSIP_MESSAGE parse, the 8-block SMSG_NPC_TEXT_UPDATE parse, and the reference greeting pick (weighted random draw over non-empty blocks in the NPC-gender column, <= predicate, no cross-gender fallback). MSUI implements the wire completely and correctly (GossipPackets.ParseMenu/ParseText, WorldSession.GossipHello/GossipSelect/NpcTextQuery, SMSG_GOSSIP_COMPLETE handled) but collapses greeting selection.

openItems.text: Greeting selection: GossipPackets.ParseText keeps only block 0 of the 8 SMSG_NPC_TEXT_UPDATE blocks (probabilities skipped), instead of Benilla's select_greeting weighted draw with NPC-gender column choice - multi-block NPC texts always show the first block regardless of weights
